Current context, the latest run record and session totals use different scopes. Do not add them together. Unknown values are not zero.
Estimated context for the current model request, not the sum of this conversation. Model limits come from its configuration.

Cache reads, cache writes and uncached input use the application normalized prompt breakdown. Hit rate is cache reads divided by normalized input. Providers report different fields; missing data stays unknown. The latest record may aggregate multiple requests within one run.
Reasoning tokens are normally a subset of output, not an extra amount to add. Totals preserve existing accounting. Subagent breakdowns must not be counted twice.
Average wait to the first token, excluding later generation.
Output tokens divided by decoding time, excluding tools.
Cumulative duration for this scope; parallel time differs from wall clock.
Subtask breakdown; avoid counting it again in totals.
Turns, execution steps and request counts are separate metrics.
Recorded compaction/archive/payback values; never substitute another scope.
